@graph.name: Cascade Bridge Adapter profile
@graph.description: An RO-Crate 1.2 Profile Crate for a Cascade Bridge Adapter: what an adapter's crate names in conformsTo. Its requirements are profile.ttl and must/ in this directory, which rocrate-validator runs; one of them validates the crate and its test manifest as one graph against shapes/bridge.shapes.ttl. The profile IRI does not dereference yet. DRAFT: no compatibility is promised before a numbered v1. The shapes and the vocabulary are web-based data entities because they are outside this crate's root, and the profile IRI is identifier rather than the root's @id because a crate's root @id is ./.

@graph.name: Cascade Bridge shapes
@graph.description: The SHACL shapes an adapter's crate and test manifest are validated against as one graph, each with its own location as base. Requires SHACL-SPARQL.

@graph.name: Cascade Bridge vocabulary
@graph.description: The bridge: vocabulary, https://ns.cascadeprotocol.org/bridge/v1-draft#: the adapter terms an adapter's crate root entity and envelopes use, and the test terms its test manifest uses on top of W3C's mf: test-manifest vocabulary. In the repository at vocab/bridge.ttl.
